20:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: Monday Night Kickoff
The legendary Monday Night Football crew of Joe Buck, Troy Aikman, and Lisa Salters preview the upcoming Monday Night Football action.

20:15 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NFL Football
The Rams host the Bills at SoFi Stadium. Buffalo lost its previous game to New England 29-26, while the Rams have alternated wins and losses. The Rams rely on Matthew Stafford, who has six touchdowns; Buffalo looks to Josh Allen, who has six as well.
